senses.gloss: to divide, dismember (of the basilisk whose look is believed to cause a person’s limbs to fall apart, v. עֶכֶס, a.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>, a. e., quot. s. v. <cite ref="N01328"><he>נָשַׁל</he></cite>; cmp. <he>יַפְרִישׁ</he> <cite ref="Proverbs 23:32">Prov. XXIII, 32</cite>).
Targ. Is. XIV, 29 מְפָרֵית (some ed. מַפְרִית Af.; Var. ed. Lag. מפריד; ed. Wil. מפריח; h. text פעופף).
Ib. LIX, 5 מְפָרְתִין ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. מפרחין).—[Targ. Prov. XXIII, 32 דפריח, ed. Lag. פאריח, prob. to be read: דפָרֵית, Part. Pe.; h. text יפריש, v. supra.]

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah, Petichta 7">Lam. R. to II, 10</cite> <he>הוון חמשא … ומְפָרְתִין ליה בנבוכדנצר וכ׳</he> (read: <cite ref="B00537"><he>ביה</he></cite>; Ar. <he>ופרטין</he>) five kings were sitting and sneering at Nebuchadnezzar in the presence of Zedekiah; <he>אף הוא מְפָרְתֵיה לנב׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>פרטיה</he>, Var. <cite ref="Q00138"><he>פדרת</he></cite>, corr. acc.) he, likewise, sneered &c.
<cite ref="Beitzah 2a:3">Bets. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>אוכלא דאִפְּרַת היא</he> the egg is considered as a broken-off piece of food (part of the hen, not as an independent creation).
<cite ref="Pesachim 85a:14">Pes. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>כמאן דמִפַּרְתֵי דמי</he> they are to be considered as if they were separated; <cite ref="Chullin 73a">Ḥull. 73ᵃ</cite>
